items.markdown:
Arey (known as [Arey Grey](https://arey.com/) ) is `a functional beauty and haircare brand that targets aging, slowing down the graying process, and supporting hair repigmentation from the inside out`.[[1]](https://arey.com/)[[2]](https://credobeauty.com/collections/arey)

### Core Products & System

- **Not Today, Grey™ Supplement:** A daily oral supplement with B vitamins, Fo-Ti root, copper, PABA, and black sesame to support melanin and pigment health.[[1]](https://arey.com/products/not-today-grey)
- **To The Root® Scalp Serum:** A topical, oil-free serum powered by their patented Mela-9 Complex and biomimetic peptides to nourish hair roots.[[1]](https://arey.com/products/to-the-root-serum)
- **Washes & Treatments:** Includes *Wash* shampoo, *Smooth* conditioner, *Masque* , and scalp exfoliants.[[1]](https://arey.com/collections/shop-all)[[2]](https://arey.com/)

### How It Works & Science

- **Target Audience:** Most effective for individuals with 0% to 30% gray hair who still have active melanin in the root. It does not turn fully white hair back to color, as white hair lacks melanin.[[1]](https://arey.com/pages/how-it-works)[[2]](https://www.innerbody.com/arey-grey-reviews)
- **Clinical Results:** A 6-month clinical study of 173 participants showed that 88% had fewer or no increase in gray hairs, active users saw a 13% decrease in grays (compared to a 10% increase in a placebo group), and users experienced thicker, fuller hair.[[1]](https://arey.com/)[[2]](https://www.thequalityedit.com/articles/arey-status-update-review)
- **Timeline:** Results require consistent daily use over 3 to 6 months.[[1]](https://arey.com/products/the-system)[[2]](https://arey.com/products/to-the-root-serum)

If you're looking into Arey, let me know:

- What **percentage of gray hair** you currently have
- Whether you are dealing with **dryness, thinning, or texture changes** 

I can help you figure out if the routine is a good fit.
